fusions.name: Seam Finder
fusions.desc: A precise peck that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target 25% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Stitching Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 4 darts at once, each dealing 5 damage. Your afflictions on a target hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinprick Bulwark
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Sharp Eye
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a darting strike hits the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
